signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: Your rolls and photos stay. Sign in again any time.

editCard.title: Edit card
editCard.note: Your frames are signed with this name from now on.

username.title: Username
username.limit: You can change it twice every 14 days
username.body: Your old handle becomes free for anyone after the change.
username.laterBody: Usernames change at most twice every 14 days, so people can find each other.

password.title: Password
password.socialBodyApple: There’s no Everglow password to change. Manage your Apple ID in Settings › Apple Account.
password.socialBodyGoogle: There’s no Everglow password to change. Manage your Google Account in its settings.
password.socialBodyOther: There’s no Everglow password to change. Manage it where you sign in.
